title: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
hook_before: Adam Mosseri says public negativity around AI is going to get worse.
script:
Instagram boss Adam Mosseri predicts rising AI negativity.
The Instagram head spoke on the Colin and Samir podcast.
He noted that students are booing tech CEOs at graduation ceremonies.
Mosseri believes this dislike extends far beyond just young people and creatives.
He made these comments while discussing new widescreen features for the app.
Many users remain concerned about where this technology is heading next.
Do you feel the same way about AI today?
